ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions occupy the lateral lobes. A central low-intensity black wedge originates from the peduncle, extending upward and outward. Distinct high-frequency black mottling is present along the trailing edge of the left lobe and the interior trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency micro-serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, with larger, irregular pixel-amplitude peaks (5-15 pixels) concentrated near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the superior margins of both lobes, tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast white/tan pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips and upper trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-vertical low-intensity linear streaks on the mid-left lobe; several faint, unaligned scratches on the upper white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular, concentric ring-shaped scarring pattern located on the interior white field of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'eye-like' pigmentation mark featuring a dark circular center within the white field near the central black-white boundary on the right lobe.
